name: Lateral Side Bend Stretch

instructions.description: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and one arm reaching overhead.
Lengthen upward first, then gently bend the trunk to the opposite side without twisting.
Keep both feet grounded and the pelvis mostly level.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold each side with easy breathing.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform seated to reduce balance demands.

commentsNotes: Avoid collapsing forward during the bend.
Make the movement about length, not compression.
